namespace = agot_plus_fix_ages

# Called only after this character crosses from age < 16 to age >= 16.
# No delay: use the character's own ROOT for AGOT education and crush effects.
agot_plus_fix_ages.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes
	trigger = {
		is_alive = yes
		age >= 16
	}
	immediate = {
		# Event chains may inherit saved targets. Rebuild all optional cleanup
		# targets from this character instead of reusing an earlier character's.
		clear_saved_scope = educator
		clear_saved_scope = victim
		clear_saved_scope = bully
		clear_saved_scope = crush
		clear_saved_scope = crushed_crush
		clear_saved_scope = root_crush
		clear_saved_scope = hostage
		clear_saved_scope = education_memory
		clear_saved_scope = new_memory
		asoiaf_alternative_ages_cleanup_effect = yes
	}
}
Reason: Isolate the adulthood cleanup in a hidden character event with the aged character as ROOT. Clear inherited optional targets; reuse the original cleanup and AGOT education behavior.
